Eminent Nuclear Scientist and Left Theorist M.P. Parameswaran Dies at 91

M.P. Parameswaran, a notable nuclear scientist and a Left theorist, passed away at the age of 91. His death was reported by multiple outlets, highlighting his dual contributions to science and political thought. Parameswaran was recognized for his work in nuclear science and his association with Leftist ideology.
